title: 第五章 有仇就报第六章 代天执法
content_zh:
武者擅战，道门擅法。
一般来说，道门很难在正面战斗中打败同级武者。
武者手上有武器和没武器，差别太大了。
周无纪虽然急着报仇出气，对自己剑法也颇有自信，却也不愿意冒险。
要是张无定手里有剑，说不得只能用阴雷珠解决对方。
张无定浑然不知周无纪就在旁边窥伺，他正在慷慨激昂的对着一众师弟、仆役讲话。
“师父被逆徒所害，我向北极天帝发誓，一定要斩杀周无纪，为师父报仇雪恨！”
他说着一指前方众人：“大家都是见证人！”
“见证什么？见证你颠倒黑白、欺师灭祖？”一个声音从张无定身后传来。
张无定大怒，这时候还有人敢冒头出来挑衅？
但他转即觉得不对，这声音非常熟悉，正是周无纪！
众多弟子、仆役也都看到了周无纪，一盏盏油灯照耀下，周无纪脸色平静如水不见喜怒。
不知为什么，众人却觉得周无纪这副表情和高高在上北极天帝神像有些相似，都有种难以测度的意味。
众人都很震惊，周无纪杀师叛门，怎么还敢回来？而且，周无纪这副样子大异平常，的确很古怪！
张无定更是急忙转身，他看到周无纪也很是惊愕。
周无纪怎么有胆子跑出来？！
张无定原本有些看不上周无纪，武功不行道法不行，又是温吞水的性子，做事做人都是平平。
要不是李一元偏爱，藏龙观哪里轮得到周无纪做二师兄。
正因为一直轻视周无纪，他才会立即就下定决心配合方无真，一起解决周无纪。
关键时刻，周无纪却给他上了一课。

那莫名其妙的火焰爆发手段还不算什么，厉害之处在于周无纪迅速果决直接反击，没有任何的犹豫。
张无定也由此改变了对周无纪的看法，这家伙不能小看！
周无纪不太可能因为恼怒跑出来辩解，所以，这家伙想干什么？
难道从李一元遗物里找到了什么威力巨大法器？只是周无纪无法吐纳元炁，什么法器也无法施展威力。
想仗着七星剑的锋锐杀他？那不是做梦么！
张无定虽然恨不得一拳打爆周无纪脑袋，但他猜不透周无纪打什么主意，也没有妄动。
在场众人不论是正式弟子还是杂役，都是四明县出身。谁敢不听他的。
他们人多势众，他更没必要着急冒险。
周无纪看到张无定脸色变幻不定，却没有急吼吼冲上来动手，就猜到了张无定不想冒险。
在一起修行数年，周无纪对张无定、方无真他们都颇为了解。
他毕竟觉醒宿慧，心智成熟。
以他来看，张无定性子自信又强硬，就是缺少急智。方无真有急智却没有耐心做事。
也正是因为张无定对自己铁虎拳非常自信，在这种特殊时刻，他还是没有随身佩剑。
方无真却总喜欢随身带着剑。
一切都是有迹可循。
周无纪晋级八品服炁，精神力量大增，这会还有余裕从容去思考这些细节。
对方人多，不能给张无定把人手组织起来的机会。
周无纪喝道：“北极天帝在上，今日且看弟子诛灭杀师逆徒张无定、方无真！”
作为道门修士，师父李一元违反戒律引动阴雷而死，死得太难看了。
传出去师父一辈子声名都毁了。
content_en:
Warriors are good at fighting, and Taoists are good at law.
Generally speaking, it is difficult for a Taoist sect to defeat a warrior of the same level in a head-on battle.
There is a huge difference between a warrior with weapons and without weapons.
Although Zhou Wuji was eager to take revenge and was quite confident in his swordsmanship, he was unwilling to take risks.
If Zhang Wuding had a sword in his hand, he would have no choice but to use Yin Lei Pearl to deal with the opponent.
Zhang Wuding had no idea that Zhou Wuji was watching from the side. He was speaking impassionedly to a group of junior brothers and servants.
"Master was killed by a traitor. I swear to the Arctic Emperor that I will kill Zhou Wuji and avenge Master!"
He pointed to the people in front of him as he spoke: "Everyone is a witness!"
"Witness what? Witness that you confuse right and wrong, deceive your teachers and destroy your ancestors?" A voice came from behind Zhang Wuding.
Zhang Wuding was furious. At this time, would anyone dare to come forward and provoke?
But he suddenly felt something was wrong. The voice was very familiar. It was Zhou Wuji!
Many disciples and servants also saw Zhou Wuji. Under the illumination of oil lamps, Zhou Wuji's face was as calm as water, without any emotion or anger.
For some reason, everyone felt that Zhou Wuji's expression was somewhat similar to that of the high-altitude North Pole Heavenly Emperor statue, both of which had an unpredictable meaning.
Everyone was shocked. Zhou Wuji killed his master and betrayed his family. How could he dare to come back? Moreover, Zhou Wuji's appearance was very unusual and indeed very strange!
Zhang Wuding turned around hastily, and he was also shocked when he saw Zhou Wuji.
How could Zhou Wuji have the guts to run out? !
Zhang Wuding originally looked down on Zhou Wuji. He was not good at martial arts and Taoism. He also had a warm-tempered temperament and was mediocre in both work and life.
If it weren't for Li Yiyuan's preference, Hidden Dragon Temple wouldn't have had Zhou Wuji's turn as the second senior brother.
Precisely because he had always despised Zhou Wuji, he immediately made up his mind to cooperate with Fang Wuzhen and deal with Zhou Wuji together.
At the critical moment, Zhou Wuji taught him a lesson.
The inexplicable flame bursting method was nothing. What was so powerful was that Zhou Wuji counterattacked quickly and decisively without any hesitation.
Zhang Wuding also changed his view of Zhou Wuji. This guy should not be underestimated!
It is unlikely that Zhou Wuji would come out to defend himself out of anger, so what does this guy want to do?
Could it be that some powerful magical weapon was found in Li Yiyuan's relics? It's just that Zhou Wuji couldn't breathe in Yuan Qi, and no magic weapon could exert its power.
Want to kill him with the sharpness of the Seven Star Sword? Isn’t that a dream?
Although Zhang Wuding wanted to blow Zhou Wuji's head off with one punch, he couldn't guess what Zhou Wuji had in mind, so he didn't act rashly.
Everyone present, whether they are formal disciples or handymen, are all from Siming County. Who dares not to listen to him.
They were outnumbered, and there was no need for him to take risks in a hurry.
Zhou Wuji guessed that Zhang Wuding didn't want to take risks when he saw Zhang Wuding's expression changing, but he didn't rush forward to take action.
After practicing together for several years, Zhou Wuji got to know Zhang Wuding and Fang Wuzhen quite well.
After all, he awakened to Su Hui and matured mentally.
From his point of view, Zhang Wuding was confident and tough, but lacked quick wit. Fang Wuzhen is quick-witted but impatient.
It is precisely because Zhang Wuding is very confident in his Iron Tiger Fist that at this special moment, he still does not carry a sword with him.
Fang Wuzhen always likes to carry a sword with him.
Everything is traceable.
Zhou Wuji advanced to the eighth level of Fuqi, and his mental strength increased greatly. Now he would have enough time to think about these details calmly.
The other party had many people and could not give Zhang Wuding a chance to organize his people.
Zhou Wuji shouted: "Your Majesty, the North Pole Heavenly Emperor, today let's watch our disciples kill their master and rebel disciples Zhang Wuding and Fang Wuzhen!"
As a Taoist monk, Master Li Yiyuan violated the commandments and caused Yin Lei to die. His death was too ugly.
If word spreads, Master's reputation will be ruined for the rest of his life.
